Name: Better Gemstones and Minerals Animated - DGA Conversion
Author: GaLaxY256
TagLine: Add animations for the mod "Better Gems and Minerals" from cometkins. (56 animations). Converted to DGA for better performance.
Description:
Better Gems and Minerals Animated
Dynamic Game Assets Conversion by GaLaxY256

        This is the Dynamic Game Assets conversion of [undare](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/12004908)'s [Better Gemstone Animated](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6930) mod, featuring 56 animations added to [cometkin](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38715215)'s [Better Gems and Minerals](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5443) (Check this mod since animations are not added for all minerals, like Mudstone) with little to no performance hit compared to Content Patcher Animations.

INSTALLATION:

*   Download and install [Dynamic Game Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365)  and its requirements. (Optional: Download and install [Generic Config Mod Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)  for ease of changing config files)

*   Download and install this mod.

*   Enjoy! :)
**CONFIGURATION OPTIONS:**

*   Every gemstone can be enabled/disabled by editing config.json generated after running the game with mod installed. For the ease of changing config though, it is recommended to use GMCM(linked above) instead of manually editing config.json.

(Also please endorse this mod if you love it as it helps me a lot <3 )
